name: Financial Instrument Attributes SD 3
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action option securities movement security details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: xPath to the element that is being extended.

DTCSecurityTransferableFlag.name: DTC Security Transferable Flag
DTCSecurityTransferableFlag.definition: Indicates whether or not the newly issued securities are transferable by the agent. This flag is specific to DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

CSDDisbursedSecurityDetails.name: CSD Disbursed Security Details
CSDDisbursedSecurityDetails.definition: Details of security that DTC will distribute as part of the entitlement.

DTCDisbursedSecurityAssetType.name: DTC Disbursed Security Asset Type
DTCDisbursedSecurityAssetType.definition: Further classification of DTC disbursed security instruments into (issue) asset types at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

DTCDisbursedSecurityAssetClass.name: DTC Disbursed Security Asset Class
DTCDisbursedSecurityAssetClass.definition: Classification of DTC disbursed security instruments into asset classes at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

BabyBondDenomination.name: Baby Bond Denomination
BabyBondDenomination.definition: Dollar amount attributed to the bond when the par value is less than 1000.

DisbursedSecurityEligibilityFlag.name: Disbursed Security Eligibility Flag
DisbursedSecurityEligibilityFlag.definition: Indicates whether the disbursed security is eligible at CSD (for example in the US - DTC, The Depository Trust Corporation).
